title: CKA mock exam 1 - review
description: Fifteen questions across every domain, weighted like the exam. Aim for exam pace: under four minutes each.

questions.prompt: A Pod is stuck in Pending and its events say 0/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint. What is the quickest fix that keeps the taint?

options.text: Remove the taint from the node
Add a matching toleration to the Pod

questions.explanation: A toleration lets the Pod onto the tainted node without changing the node for everyone else.

questions.prompt: Which command saves an etcd snapshot on a kubeadm cluster?
questions.explanation: snapshot save is etcdctl with the endpoint and the client certificates; etcdutl does the restore.

questions.prompt: kubectl drain node01 fails because of a Pod not managed by a controller. Which flag lets the drain proceed?
questions.explanation: --force evicts unmanaged Pods; --ignore-daemonsets is for DaemonSet Pods, which drain would otherwise refuse.

questions.prompt: A Service has no endpoints although its Pods are Running. What is the most likely cause?

options.text: The Service selector does not match the Pod labels

questions.explanation: Endpoints are computed from the selector; a mismatch gives an empty list even with healthy Pods.

questions.prompt: Which file does the kubelet read static Pod manifests from on a kubeadm control plane?
questions.explanation: staticPodPath in the kubelet config points at /etc/kubernetes/manifests by default.

questions.prompt: What does kubectl rollout undo deployment/web do?

options.text: Rolls back to the previous revision

questions.explanation: undo reverts to the previous ReplicaSet; --to-revision picks a specific one.

questions.prompt: Which object grants a user permission to list nodes?

options.text: A Role bound with a RoleBinding
A ClusterRole bound with a ClusterRoleBinding

questions.explanation: Nodes are cluster-scoped, so the permission has to come from a ClusterRole.

questions.prompt: A PVC stays Pending with a StorageClass whose volumeBindingMode is WaitForFirstConsumer. What makes it bind?

options.text: A Pod that uses the PVC

questions.explanation: WaitForFirstConsumer delays binding until a Pod schedules, so the volume is created near the Pod.

questions.prompt: Which command prints all Pod names with their node as two columns?
questions.explanation: custom-columns with JSONPath expressions is the exam's way to shape output exactly.

questions.prompt: After kubeadm upgrade apply on the control plane, what still has to be upgraded by hand there?
questions.explanation: kubeadm upgrades the control plane static Pods; the kubelet and kubectl binaries are OS packages.

questions.prompt: Which NetworkPolicy field makes a policy apply to egress traffic?
questions.explanation: policyTypes decides which directions the policy governs; without Egress listed, egress is untouched.

questions.prompt: A node is NotReady. Which is the first thing to check on that node?
questions.explanation: The kubelet reports the node; if it is down or misconfigured, the node is NotReady.

questions.prompt: Which command creates a Pod and a ClusterIP Service for it in one go?
questions.explanation: --expose on kubectl run creates the Service alongside the Pod.

questions.prompt: Where does a kubeadm cluster keep the CA certificate the API server uses?
questions.explanation: kubeadm writes the cluster CA to /etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt and the component certs beside it.

questions.prompt: Which JSONPath prints the image of the first container of every Pod?
questions.explanation: items[*] walks every Pod; containers[0].image reaches the first container's image.
